rationale: The short thesis remains intact as RMD continues to consolidate in the bottom 3.3% of its intraday range, well below both the 5-minute 9-EMA ($233.56) and session VWAP ($237.11). A recent test of the 9-EMA at $233.65 was immediately rejected to close on the candle low ($232.87), indicating sellers are still defending overhead resistance ahead of a potential breakdown below $232.36. Broader market weakness (SPY -1.53%) and heavy relative volume (4.55x) continue to support downside continuation.
